page.title: Plan your restaurant’s next month of content
page.description: Choose a goal, set your content direction, then select a package and review the monthly schedule.

goal.title: What would you most like customers to do?
goal.description: Choose one main goal. Each goal has observable measures so you can review the results.

offer-reach.title: Let more people know about your lunch offer

menu-views.title: Get more people to view your lunch menu
menu-views.metric: Track menu visits and menu link clicks

offer-redemptions.title: Get customers to claim or use an offer

online-bookings.title: Bring in more online bookings
online-bookings.metric: Track booking link clicks and completed bookings

dish-discovery.title: Promote a signature dish or new item

goal.activityTitle: Add dates and offer details, if applicable
goal.activityHint: For example: Weekday lunch set for €12.50, available November 1–30

direction.title: Brand & content direction
direction.description: Tell us who you want to reach, what to feature, and how you want the visuals to feel.
direction.featuredTitle: What would you like to feature?

lunch-offers.title: Lunch or set-menu offers
lunch-offers.hint: Include price, hours, and offer terms

new-seasonal.title: New or seasonal items
new-seasonal.hint: Introduce what is new and when it is available

events.title: Events and celebrations
events.hint: Seasonal menus, group dining, or special occasions

other.title: Other highlights
other.hint: Add another priority for this month

direction.specificOfferPlaceholder: For example: Lunch set €12.50, Monday–Friday, 12–3 pm; includes miso soup and salmon rolls. Please share accurate prices, terms, and highlights.
direction.campaignDetails: Other campaign details and required information
direction.campaignDetailsPlaceholder: Describe the campaign, what you want customers to do, and any details that must be accurate.
direction.audience: Who would you like to reach?
direction.audiencePlaceholder: Nearby office workers, students, families, groups…

appetizing.title: Bright and appetizing
appetizing.hint: Bring out the colour and details of each dish

warm.title: Warm and atmospheric
warm.hint: Show the space and dining experience

minimal.title: Clean menu style
minimal.hint: Make offers, prices, and hours easy to scan

follow-brand.title: Follow our existing brand
follow-brand.hint: Use the logo, colours, and examples you provide

direction.platformsHint: Choose at least one. We’ll distribute monthly posts to fit each platform.
direction.tiktokNeedsFeedPlatform: Select Instagram or Facebook too. TikTok is limited to a set number of video posts in each package.
direction.brandReferencesPlaceholder: Brand colours, website, or social profile links
direction.photosHint: Up to 6 images. Real photos help us use your dishes and brand assets.
direction.restrictions: Facts to respect and things to avoid
direction.restrictionsPlaceholder: Allergens, claims we cannot make, required terms, or elements to avoid…
direction.previewImage: Real dish photos + clear offer details
direction.previewTitle: Great lunch, at a great price
direction.previewHint: Final visuals will reflect your featured items, brand assets, and photos.

package.title: Choose your content package
package.description: Set your goal and creative direction first, then choose a monthly content volume. The calendar updates with your package.
package.examplePrice: Example pricing; final scope will be confirmed after submission.
package.calendarHint: With TikTok selected, Starter includes 4 TikTok videos and Growth includes 8. Remaining posts are split across your selected Instagram and Facebook accounts.
package.stepLabel: Step 3 of 4 · Select a service package

errors.invalidBrief: Please check the required details and select at least one featured item.
errors.invalidDates: Enter both offer dates and make sure the end date is not before the start date.
errors.choosePlatform: Choose at least one publishing platform.
errors.chooseFeedPlatform: TikTok is limited to 4 videos on Starter and 8 on Growth. Select Instagram or Facebook for the remaining posts.
errors.photosTooLarge: The combined photo size must be 10 MB or less.
errors.photoTooLarge: One of the photos is too large.
errors.invalidPhotoFormat: Use PNG, JPEG, or WebP photos.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn’t save your request. Please try again.

social.title: Connect your social accounts
social.description: Connect each platform separately so the team can prepare publishing for the accounts you choose.
social.signInHint: Sign in or create a PoStory account in a new tab, then return here to connect your platforms.
social.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the authorization window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
social.connectionFailed: Could not start the connection. Please try again.
social.optionalHint: Connecting accounts is optional. You can submit your request now and connect later from your restaurant account.

statusPage.title: Campaign request
statusPage.successDescription: Your request is now in the team’s review queue. Connecting a social account does not publish anything by itself; the ads will be created and reviewed with you before publishing.

nextSteps.review: The team reviews your goals, offer details, and selected platforms.
nextSteps.preview: When the ad creatives are ready, their images and captions will appear on this page.
nextSteps.approve: Review each creative here, request changes, and follow its scheduled or published status.

statusPage.trackingDescription: Save this private page link. Return here to see your request status and review the ads as they are added.
statusPage.contentSectionDescription: Your creative previews, captions, and review actions will be shown here.
statusPage.noContentYet: No ad creative is ready yet. This page will show the preview here once the team starts adding content.
statusPage.planDescription: Connect this request to your PoStory account. Your team can keep the plan, upcoming content, review requests, and publishing progress together in one place.
statusPage.publishingNote: Approval confirms the creative. Your account must be connected to the selected social platforms and have an active publishing plan before posts can be scheduled.

claimPage.invalidLink: This restaurant request link is invalid
claimPage.title: Connect your restaurant account
claimPage.description: Once connected, your team can build and manage the restaurant marketing plan here, including campaign themes, upcoming content, reviews, and publishing status.
claimPage.alreadyConnected: This request is already connected to an account. If it belongs to you, continue to your restaurant plan.

claimForm.matchHint: We’ll match this request with the verified email address on your PoStory account.

errors.verifiedEmailMismatch: Sign in with the verified email address you provided with the restaurant request.
errors.alreadyLinked: This restaurant request is already linked to another account.
